blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The attention operation is naively position invariant. However, positional information is fundamental to natural language, and therefore a variety of explicit position encodings have been developed in transformer-based models, such as rotary position encoding (RoPE). Although explicit position encodings have long been assumed to be required, recent methods that interleave local mixing layers, such as sliding window attention (SWA) and gated linear attention, while not encoding position (NoPE) in global attention layers has recently been shown to be successful at scale. How and why this approach works is not well-understood. In this paper, we develop an explanation of how hybrid models of this sort can implicitly encode position at global NoPE layers. Supported by both theoretical and empirical evidence, our central argument is that SWA and gated linear attention induce a recency bias in the residual stream that propagates to, and is selected by, the global attention logits. Moreover, in contrast to the implicit position encodings found in models with only global NoPE attention, in which positional information arises solely from the causal mask, the recency bias in hybrid models can be maintained across long sequences. In addition to deepening our understanding of how hybrid models encode position, these findings may provide insights for how to encode position in a way that can extrapolate to longer sequence lengths indefinitely.
blocks.zh: 注意力行动天真无常 然而,位置信息对于自然语言至关重要,因此在变压器型号中开发了各种明确的位置编码,如旋转位置编码(ROPE). 尽管长期以来人们一直认为需要明确的定位编码,但最近一些将局部搅拌层相互隔开的方法,如滑动窗口注意力(SWA)和闸门线性注意力,同时在全球注意力层中没有编码位置(NoPE),这些方法最近被证明在规模上是成功的. 这种办法如何运作以及为什么运作,并没有得到很好的理解。 在本文中,我们阐述了这种混合模型如何可以隐含地编码在全球无线环境层的位置。 在理论证据和经验证据的支持下,我们的核心论点是,西南洋分公司和有门线性关注在剩余流中诱发了因应性偏差,这种偏差传播给全球关注记录员,并由他们选择。 此外,与只有全局NoPE关注的模型中发现的隐含位置编码形成对比,其中位置信息完全来自因果面具,而混合模型中的后置偏差可以维持在长序列中. 除了加深我们对混合模型如何编码位置的理解外,这些发现可能为如何以可以无限推导到较长序列长度的方式编码位置提供了洞察力.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Distinguishing tokens by their position is a vital component of language modeling ( Dufter et al., 2022 ) . Since self-attention by itself is permutation invariant, attention layers in large language models (LLMs) typically utilize position encodings (PEs), which explicitly represent either the absolute or relative position of queries and keys. However, commonly used PEs such as rotary positional encoding ( Su et al., 2024 , RoPE;) incur computational overhead and make length extension and extrapolation difficult. Removing explicit PE (a method called NoPE) has met with mixed success: NoPE does not match the in-domain performance of the same architecture with explicit PE, although it can provide some improvements in length extrapolation whereas the performance of RoPE and other explicit position embeddings tend to collapse quickly beyond their training sequence length ( Haviv et al., 2022 ; Kazemnejad et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 按其位置区分符号是语言建模的重要组成部分(Dufter等人,2022年). 由于自我注意本身是常态的,所以大语言模型(LLMs)中的注意层通常使用位置编码(PEs),这明确代表了查询和密钥的绝对或相对位置. 然而,常用的PE,如旋转位置编码(Su等人,2024年,ROPE;)则发生计算间接费用,使长度扩展和外推困难. 清除明显的PE(一种称为无PE的方法)取得了好坏参半的成功: NoPE不匹配同一架构的域内性能与明确的PE,虽然它能提供一些长度外推的改进,而ROPE和其他明确位置嵌入的性能往往会迅速崩溃,超出其训练序列长度(Haviv等人,2022年;Kazemnejad等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Separately, to mitigate the computational and memory costs of attention across long sequences, so-called hybrid architectures that interleave either sliding window attention (SWA) or gated linear layers with global attention layers are increasingly used at scale. Interestingly, as hybrid models have become more widespread, there has been a shift in the global attention layers from using RoPE ( Gemma Team, 2024 ) to p-RoPE ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) to, most recently, NoPE. Notably, Kimi K3 interleaved global NoPE with a gated linear variant called KDA ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 另外,为了降低长序关注的计算和内存成本,越来越多的人大规模使用所谓的混合结构,这些结构要么是滑动窗口关注(SWA),要么是带门的线性层与全球关注层。 有趣的是,随着混合模型的日益普及,全球关注层从使用RoPE(Gemma Team,2024年)到p-RoPE(Quen Team,2025年)的转变到最近的NOPE. 值得注意的是,Kimi K3与一个称为KDA的门状线性变体(Kimi Team等人,2026年)互换了全球NoPE。

blocks.en: However, there are remaining questions concerning how such models utilize and represent position in their NoPE attention layers, an issue that is critical to their long context performance. To our knowledge, only one prior paper has studied how hybrid models represent position in NoPE layers, and their main finding is that they do not represent absolute position ( Puvvada et al., 2025 ) at all. However, this result leaves open the question of whether such models may learn to encode relative position in their NoPE layers.
blocks.zh: 然而,关于这些模型如何利用并代表其在无污染环境关注层中的地位,仍然存在问题,这个问题对其长期的背景业绩至关重要。 据我们所知,只有一份先前的论文研究了混合模型如何代表无极层中的位置,其主要结论是它们根本不代表绝对位置(Puvvada等人,2025年)。 然而,这一结果留下了这样一个问题,即这些模型能否学会编码其无线环境层中的相对位置。

blocks.en: In this paper, we present novel theoretical and empirical evidence that hybrid architectures can and do develop relative PEs at their NoPE layers. Unlike other explicit relative PEs such as RoPE, hybrid architectures implicitly encode relative position via the interactions between local or linear layers and subsequent NoPE layers. Specifically, the SWA or gated linear layers introduce a recency bias in the residual stream that propagates to, and is selected by, the global NoPE attention logits and then accentuated through depth. We support this account in two complementary ways: (i) Theoretically, we show mathematically how SWA approximates a moving-average convolution in expectation, inducing a recency bias in its output that transfers into the residual stream, propagates through intervening layers, and is selected by the global NoPE attention logits. (ii) Empirically, we demonstrate the existence of the predicted recency bias in the residual stream and NoPE attention logits across depth. We show this bias is present at initialization and strengthens throughout training. We validate this in hybrid models interleaving global NoPE attention with SWA (with RoPE and NoPE) and KDA (Appendix E )
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了新的理论和经验证据,证明混合结构能够并且确实在它们的NoPE层上发展相对的PE. 不同于其他显性相对PE,如ROPE,混合结构通过局部或线性层与随后的NoPE层之间的相互作用,暗含编码相对位置. 具体来说,SWA或有门的线性层在残余流中引入了恒定偏差,这种偏差向全局无线电源的注意力记录传播并由其选择,然后通过深度突出。 我们以两种相辅相成的方式支持这一说法:(一) 从理论上讲,我们从数学上表明,西澳大利亚州如何估计预期的移动-平均演化,从而导致其产出出现因应性偏差,从而转入剩余流,通过干预层进行传播,并由全球无线项目关注记录员选定。 (二) 从经验上讲,我们证明残余溪流中存在预测的再生偏差,而无线观测观测则在深度上进行。 我们显示在初始化时存在这种偏见,并在整个培训过程中加强这种偏见。 我们在混合模型中验证了这一点,这些模型与SWA(与RoPE和NoPE)和KDA(附录E)相互连接,使全球NoPE注意.

blocks.en: Theoretically, we show mathematically how SWA approximates a moving-average convolution in expectation, inducing a recency bias in its output that transfers into the residual stream, propagates through intervening layers, and is selected by the global NoPE attention logits.
blocks.zh: 从理论上讲,我们用数学来显示 SWA 如何在预期中近似于移动-平均演化, 诱导其输出的回转偏差 转移到剩余流中, 通过中间层传播, 并且被全球的 NoPE 注意记录所选择。

blocks.en: Empirically, we demonstrate the existence of the predicted recency bias in the residual stream and NoPE attention logits across depth. We show this bias is present at initialization and strengthens throughout training. We validate this in hybrid models interleaving global NoPE attention with SWA (with RoPE and NoPE) and KDA (Appendix E )
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,我们证明了残余溪流中存在预言的应变偏差,而NoPE的注意力记录则跨越深度。 我们显示在初始化时存在这种偏见,并在整个培训过程中加强这种偏见。 我们在混合模型中验证了这一点,这些模型与SWA(与RoPE和NoPE)和KDA(附录E)相互连接,使全球NoPE注意.

blocks.en: An overview of our hypothesized mechanism is provided in Figure 1 . In the following sections, we first note that existing relative PEs generally induce a recency bias (Section II ), then we introduce our core argument in three steps (Section III ). First, SWA produces a residual stream recency bias (Section IV ); second, this recency bias propagates through the intervening modules such as normalization and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs; Section V ); and third, this recency bias propagates to and is selected by the global NoPE attention logits (Section VI ).

blocks.en: II Background: Recency Bias as Relative Position Encoding
blocks.zh: 二. 背景情况 相对位置编码时的偏差

blocks.en: Relative PEs, as opposed to absolute PEs, are the industry standard in LLM architectures ( Shaw et al., 2018 ; Dufter et al., 2022 ; Su et al., 2024 ) . These PEs alter attention logits, directly or indirectly, in a way that depends on the relative distance between query and key. There are a variety of methods for encoding relative positions in attention, but the majority share the following feature:

blocks.en: Common and state-of-the-art relative position encoding methods encode relative position by creating a recency bias in attention logits . That is, given a query q i q_{i} at position i i , and a key k j k_{j} at j j , relative position encodings bias the attention logits downward as the relative distance i − j i-j increases.

blocks.en: Relative PEs encoding a recency bias is not strictly necessary ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . In principle, a relative PE applied to attention can induce any kind of bias in attention logits, as long as this bias depends directly on relative position. However, using a recency bias to encode relative position appears to work well in practice, because: (i) it provides a particularly simple positional signal for the model to learn and use (i.e., in which distance is represented directly by a smooth, monotonic change in the attention strength); and (ii) it fits the statistics of natural sequential data ( Tan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 , i.e., the tokens most important for predicting next tokens tend to be the most recent ones;) .
blocks.zh: 相对的PE对重任偏差进行编码并非绝对必要(Chen等人,2025年)。 原则上,适用于注意力的相对PE可以诱发注意力对数中的任何类型的偏差,只要这种偏差直接取决于相对位置. 然而,使用惯性偏差编码相对位置在实践中似乎效果良好,因为:(一)它为模型的学习和使用提供了特别简单的位置信号(即距离直接表现为注意力强度的平稳,单调变化);和(二)它符合自然顺序数据的统计数据(Tan等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026年,即对于预测下一个征兆最重要的征兆往往是最新的征兆;).

blocks.en:
There are generally two ways to create a relative PE in attention logits: additively or multiplicatively ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Additive encodings directly add a bias, b i − j b_{i-j} , to attention logits; i.e., s = q i ⊤ ​ k j + b i − j s=q_{i}^{\top}k_{j}+b_{i-j} , where i i and j j are the position of query and key and i − j i-j the relative position. Examples include Alibi and Fire ( Press et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , which add a fixed, data-independent bias
that decays linearly with relative distance, as well as the more recent Fox PE ( Lin et al., 2025 ) that uses a data-dependent bias. All of these explicitly induce a recency bias in attention logits, such that keys farther from the query have a larger negative bias added to their attention logits. Multiplicative PEs include a matrix, R i − j R_{i-j} , in the query-key multiplication; i.e., s = q i ⊤ ​ R i − j ​ k j s=q_{i}^{\top}R_{i-j}k_{j} , where R i − j R_{i-j} is unique to relative position i − j i-j . RoPE, arguably the best-known relative PE, rotates pairs of channels using rotation matrices in both the queries and keys. It has been observed that learned attention heads with RoPE either focus on very low-frequency channels with little resulting influence on logit decay, or they focus on high-frequency channels in such a way that they create a strong recency bias ( Barbero et al., 2025 ) . Other multiplicative PEs, like the recent Wall attention ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , create a similar kind of recency bias in a way that is data-dependent ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: Among previous work studying the position encoding resulting from NoPE, two papers are particularly relevant to this work. First, Puvvada et al. (2025) studied implicit position encodings in models with global NoPE attention, including hybrid architectures that interleave global NoPE with SWA. In particular, they trained probes to predict absolute position encoding in the residual stream embeddings, finding that the probes could predict absolute position in global NoPE architectures but not in hybrid architectures (see Haviv et al., 2022 ; Chi et al., 2023 for more evidence of absolute position encodings in global NoPE architectures). This provides evidence that hybrid NoPE architectures, unlike their global NoPE counterparts, do not encode absolute position, but leaves open the possibility that hybrid architectures could encode relative positions.
blocks.zh: 在以前研究由NoPE产生的位置编码的工作当中,有两篇论文与这项工作特别相关. 首先,Puvvada等人(2025年)研究了具有全球NoPE关注的模型中的隐含位置编码,包括将全球NoPE与SWA交互的混合结构. 尤其是,他们训练了探测器,以预测剩余流嵌入物中的绝对位置编码,发现探测器可以预测全球NoPE架构中的绝对位置,但不能预测混合结构中的绝对位置(见Haviv等人,2022年;Chi等人,2023年),以获得更多关于全球NoPE架构中绝对位置编码的证据. 这提供了证据,证明与他们的全球NoPE对像不同,混合NoPE架构没有编码绝对位置,但留下了混合架构可以编码相对位置的可能性.

blocks.en: Second, Zuo et al. (2025) showed that architectures with global NoPE attention at every layer could learn a recency bias-based PE in their residual stream, created by the asymmetric token mixing effects of attention with a causal mask. However, their analysis and empirical results only demonstrate a recency bias effect on very short sequences (approximately 30 tokens), leaving open the question of how this bias may change with sequence length. Additionally, they do not explain the conditions under which attention can make use of this recency bias in the residual stream. In this work, we apply a similar analysis to hybrid architectures with SWA layers and compare to global NoPE models. Importantly, we show that SWA has a recency bias effect on the residual stream independent of total sequence length, whereas for initialized global NoPE residuals the recency bias loses resolution even at moderate sequence lengths. Further, unlike previous works, we explain the conditions required of attention parameters to make use of this recency bias in the residual stream, and we scale our empirical results to models with 350M+ parameters trained on natural language data.
blocks.zh: 其次,Zuo等人(2025年)表明,每个层都有全局无PE关注的建筑可以在剩余流中学习基于应变偏差的PE,由注意力与因果面具的不对称符号混合效应所创造. 然而,他们的分析和实证结果只显示了对非常短的序列(约30个令牌)的回溯偏差效应,留下了这种偏差会如何随着序列长度而改变的问题. 此外,它们没有解释在何种条件下,注意力可以利用剩余流中的这种惯性偏差。 在这部作品中,我们对具有SWA层的混合结构进行了类似的分析,并与全球的NoPE模型进行了比较. 重要的是,我们表明,西西南亚对剩余流具有不依赖总序列长度的惯性偏差,而对于初始化的全球无线电波残差而言,惯性偏差即使在中等序列长度时也会失去分辨率。 此外,与之前的作品不同,我们解释了在剩余流中利用这种惯性偏差需要注意参数的条件,我们用350M+参数对自然语言数据进行培训,将我们的经验结果推广到模型.

blocks.en: III Thesis: Hybrid Architectures Implicitly Encode Relative Position at Global NoPE Layers
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 论文: 混合结构 暗中编码全球无线层的相对位置

blocks.en: We develop and support the following thesis about hybrid architectures with global NoPE attention:
blocks.zh: 我们开发并支持以下关于杂交结构的论文,并给予全球无核电站关注:

blocks.en: Local layers (e.g., SWA) output a sequence of vectors which, in expectation, have a recency bias (i.e., smaller cosine similarity with greater relative distance). These outputs then create a recency bias in the post-attention residual stream that is persistent across sequence lengths. This residual stream bias can (and does after training) get transferred through the intervening layers and to attention logits at NoPE layers, thereby creating an implicit relative position encoding in NoPE layers .
blocks.zh: 局部层(如SWA)输出一个矢量序列,在预期中,矢量具有回转偏差(即相对距离较小的余弦相似性). 然后,这些产出在留守后残留流中产生一种惯性偏差,这种偏差在序列长度之间持续存在。 这种残余流偏差可以(在训练后确实)通过中间层进行转移,并在无PE层进行注意力记录,从而在无PE层中形成隐含的相对位置编码.

blocks.en: We provide two lines of evidence that present complementary views of this effect. The theoretical analysis isolates the structural effect of one type of local layer (SWA) and outlines how the resulting recency bias can propagate through intervening modules and into the global NoPE logits. However, our analysis does not fully account for the variety of computation the model is being trained for, particularly the effects of content-dependent attention and MLPs. Our empirical analysis then verifies the existence of the residual stream and logit-based recency biases in multiple models, at varying stages of training, on both random and natural language data (for random-token controls, see Appendix D-B ). We also show how these effects generalize to hybrid architectures that use KDA (Appendix E ) as the local layer instead of SWA. Below, we first provide theoretical and then empirical preliminaries common to each step in our proposed mechanism.

Again, we approximate attention by its mean profile a d = 𝔼 ⁡ [ α i ​ ( d ) ] a_{d}=\mathbb{E}[\alpha_{i}(d)] (estimated across some number of relevant sequences). Suppose that X X has some incoming lagged cross-moment structure G X ​ ( d ) G_{X}(d) ; let A = W O ​ W V A=W_{O}W_{V} be the composed projected-value matrix and g a ​ ( k ) = ∑ s a s ​ a s + k g_{a}(k)=\sum_{s}a_{s}a_{s+k} the mean attention autocorrelation. In this setting, the SWA output is y i ≈ A ​ ∑ d = 0 w − 1 a d ​ x i − d y_{i}\approx A\sum_{d=0}^{w-1}a_{d}x_{i-d} , and its lagged cross-moment is G Y ​ ( d ) ≈ A ​ ∑ k g a ​ ( k ) ​ G X ​ ( d − k ) ​ A ⊤ = A ⁡ ( g a ∗ G X ) ​ ( d ) ​ A ⊤ , G_{Y}(d)\approx A\sum_{k}g_{a}(k)G_{X}(d-k)A^{\top}=A(g_{a}\ast G_{X})(d)A^{\top}, if output norms are concentrated (see Appendix B-A for the full derivation). Thus, the similarity structure in the output is the incoming structure mixed across distances by the mean attention autocorrelation, and then mixed across channels by the composed attention matrices. The structural effect of SWA is still present, as g a ​ ( k ) > 0 g_{a}(k)>0 if | k | < w |k|<w , and 0 otherwise. So, the window bounds the scale of the recency bias, but its effect can be amplified or dampened by the attention profile within the window. blocks.en: Empirically, we first validate the argument that SWA’s effect is structurally different from that of global NoPE, and that only the former produces a well-resolved recency bias at long sequence lengths. Figure compares the isolated first attention-branch outputs before residual addition at initialization. With increasing sequence lengths (probed via query position along an 8k-token sequence), global NoPE activations become so highly correlated that positions cannot be resolved for most distances; in contrast, SWA retains a strong distance-dependent profile across the window while flattening beyond, regardless of sequence length.
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,我们首先验证了如下论点,即SWA的效果在结构上与全球的NoPE不同,只有前者在长序列长度上产生一个解决好的回旋偏差. 图表比较了初始化时剩余添加之前的单独第一关注部门产出。 随着序列长度的增加(通过8k-token序列的查询位置进行定位),全球无线PE激活变得高度相关,以至于大多数距离无法解决位置问题;相比之下,SWA在窗口两侧保留了强烈的依赖距离的剖面,而不管序列长度如何,均在外侧平整.

blocks.en: Though the analysis above corroborates the hypothesis that SWA produces a recency bias at initialization, it is possible that this effect dissipates during training as the model focuses on learning content-dependent interactions. However, this is not the case – in fact, the recency bias strengthens during training. Figure 3 visualizes the recency profile during training at the first, middle, and last SWA layers. Across depth, the trained profiles show strengthening and subsequent attenuation relative to their peak, while remaining stronger than at initialization. Note that this effect stabilized early in training (the colorbar is logarithmic in the fraction of that scale’s total training tokens). Furthermore, the recency bias strengthens significantly with increased depth. Further analysis as well as layer-by-layer profiles are shown in Appendix B-B .
blocks.zh: 虽然上述分析证实了一种假设,即西澳大利亚州在初始化时会产生后退偏差,但这种影响在培训期间可能会消失,因为模式侧重于学习内容依赖的互动。 然而,情况并非如此,事实上,在培训期间,惯性偏见会加强。 图3在第一,中,最后一SWA层的训练中可视化了复健情况简介. 训练有素的剖面图纵深显示,相对于峰值而言,其强度和随后的衰减程度都有所提高,同时仍然比初始化时强。 请注意,这种效应在培训初期就稳定下来了(彩色栏是该比例尺总培训标志的一小部分)。 此外,随着深度的提高,审慎性偏见大大加强。 进一步的分析和逐层剖面图载于附录B-B。

blocks.en: The theoretical analysis in Section IV-A suggests that smaller SWA windows will produce a narrower and steeper recency bias in the outgoing residual stream. The distance profiles (top) and layer-wise recency gaps (bottom) in Figure 4 a verify this trend; smaller windows lead to stronger recency biases across depth (for full profile comparisons, see Figure 9 b in Appendix B ). Further, to mitigate the confound of the strong logit-based recency bias induced by RoPE within the window (which as we discussed in Section IV-A has an important contribution to the recency bias), we also verify this for models with NoPE-in-SWA. Figure 4 b shows the distance profiles and layer-wise recency gaps across window sizes for NoPE-in-SWA; in fact, the effect of window size is more pronounced, with smaller windows producing significantly stronger recency biases (for further NoPE-in-SWA results, please see Figure 12 f in Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 第四-A节中的理论分析表明,较小的西澳大利亚州窗口在向外流的剩余流中会产生更窄和更陡峭的惯性偏差. 图4中的距离剖面图(顶部)和分层(底部)折合率差距验证了这一趋势;较小的窗口导致在深度上更强烈的折合率偏差(关于完整的剖面比较,见附录B中的图9b)。 此外,为缓解RoPE在窗口内引起的强烈的基于逻辑的复健偏差的混乱(正如我们在第四节A中所讨论的那样,这种偏差对复健偏差有重要的贡献),我们还用NOPE-in-SWA对模型进行了核实。 图4b显示无西华网窗口大小之间的距离剖面图和层回转差距;事实上,窗口大小的影响更为明显,较小的窗口产生明显更强的回转偏差(关于其他无西华网窗口结果,请见附录D图12f)。

blocks.en: Given the pronounced effect of SWA window size on recency bias strength, a further question one might ask is how window size affects model performance. We find that smaller windows achieve lower loss than their larger-windowed counterparts (see Figure 5 here and Figure 12 g–h in the appendix, which report the late-training validation-loss trajectories; note that larger NoPE-in-SWA windows cause loss collapse). Although preliminary, this is promising evidence that the recency bias strength is important to such hybrid models’ success. In fact, the benefit of strengthening the recency bias effect by decreasing window size may outweigh the cost of the associated reduction in training compute so that the performance of the model improves on shorter window sizes. Also note that, since these experiments did not match compute across window sizes, the advantage for small windows is even stronger than shown here.
blocks.zh: 鉴于SWA窗口大小对惯性偏差强度的显著影响,人们可能会问的另一个问题是窗口大小如何影响模型性能. 我们发现,比起较大的窗口窗口,较小的窗口实现较低的损失(见本文图5和附录图12 g-h,其中报告了培训后期的验证-损失轨迹;注意到更大的无线网络窗口导致损失倒塌)。 这虽然是初步的,但很有希望的证据表明,对这种混合模式的成功来说,惯性偏差的力量很重要。 事实上,通过减少窗口规模来加强后退偏差效应的好处可能超过相应减少培训计算的成本,从而使模型的性能在较短的窗口规模上有所改进。 也注意,由于这些实验与不同窗口大小的计算不匹配,因此小窗口的优势甚至比这里显示的要强.

For each hidden unit, the corresponding preactivations U = w ⊤ ​ x U=w^{\top}x and V = w ⊤ ​ x ′ V=w^{\top}x^{\prime} are jointly Gaussian with correlation p p . We therefore reduce the problem to asking how the nonlinearity f f transforms this correlation, defining the resulting kernel k f ​ ( p ) k_{f}(p) ; the subsequent projection W 2 W_{2} approximately preserves this kernel at large width. Expanding f f in the Gaussian Hermite basis gives k f ​ ( p ) = ∑ n a n 2 ​ p n ∑ n a n 2 . k_{f}(p)=\frac{\sum_{n}a_{n}^{2}p^{n}}{\sum_{n}a_{n}^{2}}. The n = 0 n=0 term contributes a constant similarity floor, the n = 1 n=1 term transmits similarity linearly, and higher-order terms nonlinearly reshape the profile. blocks.en: These patterns suggest that the model seeks to learn a consistent logit recency bias across depth. However, if window size is too large (and therefore, the residual stream recency bias too weak) then the model is unable to develop a logit recency bias, resulting in performance collapse. This aligns with the spirit of our proposed mechanism: the role of local layers is to produce a residual stream recency bias available to be picked up by the global NoPE logits; within the global NoPE logits, the model learns to pick up and maintain a consistent recency bias from the residual stream across heads to serve as its position encoding in attention.
blocks.zh: 这些模式表明,该模型力求在深度中学习一致的逻辑惯性偏差。 然而,如果窗口大小太大(因此残余的流重置偏差太弱),则模型无法开发出逻辑重置偏差,导致性能崩溃. 这符合我们拟议机制的精神:局部层的作用是产生一种残余流回溯性偏差,可供全球无核电站对数接收;在全球无核电站对数中,模型学习从头顶的残余流中取出并保持一贯的回溯性偏差,作为它注意的位置。

blocks.en: VII Discussion
blocks.zh: 七、结 论 讨论情况

blocks.en: Despite their empirical success, how hybrid models interleaving SWA and global NoPE attention encode position in their global NoPE layers has remained a mystery. In this paper, we develop a novel mechanistic explanation for how such models accomplish this encoding. First, SWA creates a recency bias in its output by correlating neighboring embeddings, which emerges as a fundamental and in-built inductive bias present from initialization. Second, this recency bias is preserved by the intervening transformations (viz. residual stream addition, normalization, and MLPs). Third, it is selected by the global attention projections (to varying degrees across heads) and propagated to the global attention logits. Furthermore, this proposed mechanism may be extended to hybrid models that interleave linear layers like KDA in place of SWA (Appendix E ). This recency bias acts as a kind of implicit relative position encoding, creating effects similar to explicit relative position encodings.
blocks.zh: 尽管在经验上取得了成功,但混合模型将SWA与全球NoPE的注意编码位置在其全球NoPE层之间如何相互连接仍然是一个谜。 在本文中,我们开发了一种新的机械学解释,说明这些模型是如何实现这种编码的. 首先,SWA通过将相邻的嵌入物联系起来,在其输出中产生再生偏差,这种偏差成为初始化时出现的一种根本性的和内置的诱导偏差. 其次,这种惯性偏差通过中间的转变(viz,剩余流加成,正常化,和MLPs)得以保留. 第三,它由全球关注预测(在不同程度上跨头)选择,并传播给全球关注记录。 此外,这一拟议机制可扩展至诸如KDA等线性层相互连接的混合模型,以取代SWA(附录E)。 这种惯性偏差起到一种隐性相对位置编码的作用,产生类似于显性相对位置编码的效果.

blocks.en: Our account of how such models encode position is particularly interesting given the special capacity of hybrid models with global NoPE attention for length extension and generalization. We hypothesize that this occurs for a few reasons. First, the window provides a finite-length local scale that does not dilute as sequence length increases, and which is invariant to the absolute sequence length. Also, the position encoding learned does not radically change at distances beyond those seen in training, as is the case with RoPE, implying that extrapolation to longer sequence lengths does not introduce any serious discontinuities. Finally, this position encoding may be uniquely flexible due to residing within the residual stream geometry, which may enable expressive and easily-learned interactions with content that may be adaptively read out by the global attention heads.
blocks.zh: 我们关于这种模型编码位置如何的叙述特别有趣,因为混合模型具有特殊能力,在长度扩展和概括方面受到全球无线PE的注意。 我们假设这是出于几个原因。 首先,窗口提供了一个有限长度的局部尺度,不会随着序列长度的增加而稀释,并且与绝对序列长度不相适应. 此外,所学位置编码在距离上不会发生根本变化,超出培训中看到的距离,RoPE就是这种情况,这意味着推断较长的序列长度不会造成严重的不连续。 最后,这种位置编码可能具有独特的灵活性,因为它位于残流几何体中,这可以使表达和容易了解的内容与全球关注头可能适应性地阅读的内容进行互动。

blocks.en: Nevertheless, there are still many unknowns about how hybrid models with SWA and global NoPE attention encode position. For example, we still have not developed a complete quantitative account of how the recency bias propagates through all modules of the model, or how this affects the attenuation of the recency bias across depth and varying sequence lengths. Nor have we established a quantitative relationship between these characteristics and the extent of length generalizability. These topics are left to future work.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,对于SWA和全球NoPE注意力编码位置的混合模型仍有许多未知数. 例如,我们仍然没有制定完整的定量说明,说明复方偏差如何通过模型的所有模块传播,或者这如何影响在深度和不同序列长度之间减少复方偏差。 我们也没有在这些特征与长度可通用性的程度之间建立数量关系。 这些专题留给今后的工作处理。

blocks.en: As noted in Section IV-B , the residual stream recency bias accumulates across depth. To investigate this at finer resolution, Figure 9 a shows the residual stream recency profile following every SWA layer at the last checkpoint of training, which demonstrates that the trend of increasing recency bias through depth is notably smooth across layers. Comparing Figure 9 a to its 120M-scale companion Figure 12 c in Appendix D-A , it is particularly notable how consistent this layer-wise recency bias trend is across model scales, not only in ordering, but also in magnitude. This supports that the residual stream recency bias provides a functional role regardless of scale.

blocks.en: To supplement the comparison of window sizes in Figure 4 , Figure 9 b displays the full cosine profiles at the first, middle, and last SWA layers of different window sizes; Figure 5 in the main text shows the validation loss curves for the same range of window sizes. Together, these results show that varying window size has a clear and predictable effect on both cosine profiles and language modeling (though we cannot fully isolate its causal role).

blocks.zh: 附录C 步骤3补编:全球无污染环境继承残余流调整

blocks.en: This appendix examines how the recency structure induced by SWA and shaped by the intervening transformations analyzed in Section V is read out by global NoPE. It provides a cross-moment analysis and additional measurements supporting the readout in Section VI . We also explain how cross-moment magnitude and alignment help us understand the recency bias in both the residual stream and logits.
blocks.zh: 本附录研究了全球 " 无污染环境 " 系统如何解读由西南半球引领和由第五节分析的干预性转变所形成的合理性结构。 它提供了交叉运动分析和补充测量,支持第六节的读出。 我们还解释了交叉运动的规模和校正如何帮助我们理解残余流和对数的惯性偏差。

blocks.en: For a more fine-grained view of depth-wise patterns than provided in Figure 8 , Figure 11 a shows the mean logit profile at every global NoPE layer. As noted in Section VI-B , the pattern is different from that of the residual stream recency bias: after an initial rise, the logit recency bias is largely consistent across layers. Similarly, comparing the logit profiles for different window sizes, Figure 11 b shows a weaker relationship between recency bias and window size than in the residual stream. The relative lack of variation in the logit profiles with depth and window size suggests that, as we discussed in Section VI-B , the model seeks to develop a consistent logit-based recency bias to serve as its position encoding in attention.

blocks.en: D-A 120M-scale robustness
blocks.zh: D-A 120M级稳健性

blocks.en: To verify that the 350M-scale results of the main text are robust across model scales, we train 120M models with the same configurations of SWA window size and varying RoPE and NoPE within the window, on the same dataset and for a number of tokens comparable given the scale difference (see Appendix A ). These 120M-scale results corroborate the main-text 350M-scale results, with the same qualitative conclusions from each panel provided in the composite of Figure 12 . That is, SWA’s recency bias is present from initialization (a), strengthens with training and depth (b–c), becomes sharper with smaller windows (d–e), and propagates to and is selected by the logits (i–l).
blocks.zh: 为了核实主文本的350M级结果在模型尺度之间是强劲的,我们在窗口内对120M型进行配置相同的SWA窗口大小和不同的ROPE和NoPE的训练,在相同的数据集上,以及针对一些与比例差相当的标志(见附录A). 这些120M级的结果证实了主文本350M级的结果,图12综合部分提供了每个小组相同的定性结论。 也就是说,西澳大利亚州从初始化(a)开始就存在适应性偏差,通过培训和深度(b-c)加强(b-e),通过较小的窗口(d-e)变得更加尖锐(d-e),并向日志(i-l)传播和选择。

blocks.en: Furthermore, Figure 12 f–h displays the cosine gap for NoPE-in-SWA, as well as a comparison of the validation losses for both RoPE and NoPE within the window. Of particular note is that, in both cases, loss decreases with smaller windows despite fewer training flops, indicating that smaller windows may be beneficial, perhaps due to their ability to resolve a strong recency bias. In further support of this, with NoPE-in-SWA loss collapses entirely for larger windows; this is suggestive that, without a sufficiently strong architectural mechanism to resolve a recency bias and therefore encode position, such models fail to learn language effectively.
blocks.zh: 此外,图12 f-h显示了无锡瓦的余弦空隙,以及窗内ROPE和无锡的验证损失的比较。 特别值得注意的是,在这两种情况下,由于窗户较小而损失减少,尽管培训费减少,这表明较小的窗户可能是有益的,也许是因为它们有能力解决强烈的复健偏差。 为了进一步支持这一点,由于SWA的无PE损失完全针对较大的窗口而倒闭;这表明,如果没有足够强大的建筑机制来解决后退偏差,因此编码位置问题,这些模型无法有效地学习语言。

blocks.en: D-B Random-token controls
blocks.zh: D- B 随机键控件

blocks.en: The main analyses use natural-language sequences, as these are the natural domain of the language models we train. However, language has an underlying correlation structure that may confound the evidence for our proposed architectural mechanism. Hence, repeating the complete SWA analysis on uniformly sampled tokens from the model’s vocabulary is an important control to isolate the structural contribution from natural-language statistics. The following controls use the same query positions and lags as the TextbookChapters analyses and report results for both RoPE and NoPE within SWA (Figures 13 – 16 ; each composite groups the observables for one SWA encoding and model scale).
blocks.zh: 主要分析使用自然语言序列,因为这些是我们训练的语言模型的自然域. 然而,语言具有内在的相关性结构,可能使我们提议的建筑机制的证据混淆。 因此,从模型的词汇中重复对统一抽样的征兆进行完整的全部门办法分析,是将结构贡献从自然语言统计中分离出来的一个重要控制。 以下控件使用与《教科书》各章分析和报告SWA内部的ROPE和NoPE结果相同的查询位置和滞后(图13 - 16;每个综合组合一个SWA编码和模型尺度的可观测数据)。

blocks.en: These controls also corroborate the main-text findings. Across all four composites, we observe the recency bias present at initialization and strengthening with training and depth (a–c). SWA’s position encoding has a larger impact on the effect of window size (d–e): for NoPE-in-SWA at both model scales, we observe the same pattern of smaller windows promoting stronger recency biases; however, for RoPE-in-SWA at both scales, the trends were inconclusive, likely due to random tokens altering the learned RoPE decay profile. Finally, across all four settings, the recency bias transfers to the logits particularly for smaller windows, but this transfer is less consistent than in natural language (f–i). Overall, these results are consistent with our proposed architectural mechanism functioning, but being untuned for data outside its training distribution.

blocks.en: We empirically test whether our proposed mechanism extends to KDA-interleaved models at different scales, when using both natural language data and random-token controls. Figures 17 and 18 below show the KDA results; each row compares both model scales, and all logit panels use the head-mean convention specified in Appendix A-C . Indeed, the same empirical pattern appears: KDA layers primarily increase residual stream recency bias across depth (a–d); and later NoPE layers learn recency-biased logits (e–h). This indicates that the general mechanism we identify is not specific to SWA, but can apply to many local sequence mixers including the variety of increasingly common linear gated attention types.
blocks.zh: 在使用自然语言数据和随机键控时,我们以经验检验我们提议的机制是否扩展到不同尺度的KDA-interleaved模型。 下文图17和图18显示了KDA的结果;每行都比较两个模型的尺度,所有登录面板都使用附录A-C中规定的头形常规. 事实上,同样的经验模式也出现了:KDA层主要增加跨深度(a-d)的剩余流重力偏差;后来的NoPE层学习重力偏差对数(e-h). 这表明,我们确定的一般机制并非SWA所特有的,但可以适用于许多局部序列混合器,包括各种日益常见的线性门式关注类型.
